gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega draws each letter as if with one nib, leaving a visible gap in every c. And a slightly larger size suits it, since its lowercase nearly reaches capital height beside Fuzzy Bubbles.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta is a sans-serif whose curves never thin out, its large x-height leaving each c a wide mouth. And what stands out most is Fuzzy Bubbles' relaxed handwriting against that sturdy, thickness-steady body.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-lexend-tera: Fuzzy Bubbles writes like a relaxed hand with a drafting pen. Lexend Tera, a sans with plotter-pen lines, open curves and stepping-stone spacing, would sprawl across the page if made large.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-lexend-zetta: Small letters that climb almost to the height of the capitals give Fuzzy Bubbles its rounded, drafting-pen handwriting. Lexend Zetta's widely tracked, tall-bodied sans-serif reads slowly and steadily down the page.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-liter: Round and handwritten: Fuzzy Bubbles leads with a steady drafting-pen line. Liter follows in sans-serif with no stroke contrast and wide mouths on round forms, so extended reading stays smooth.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-mada: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles writes in rounded strokes as constant as neon tubing, small letters nearly capital height. And Mada, a sans-serif with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, reads openly across paragraphs.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-martel-sans: Round bowls with walls that never bulge give Fuzzy Bubbles a drafting-pen steadiness. But Martel Sans, a sans-serif with generous curve openings and a high mean line, lets paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-matangi: Matangi is a sans with a hefty lowercase and rounded letters left open, its strokes like twine pressed into a flat surface. Beside Fuzzy Bubbles' handwriting, that weight makes the pair feel grounded.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-maven-pro: A steady drafting-pen line in rounded, open handwriting is what Fuzzy Bubbles brings. Maven Pro, a sans-serif with a gentle monotone line and an open gap in the c, keeps that friendliness tidy.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-michroma: Michroma, a sans, gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, with curves that leave daylight and stubby ascender tips. Michroma reads unhurried and spacious under Fuzzy Bubbles' relaxed handwriting, line after line.
